about_short_description.short_description: Base Power provides home battery systems, electricity services, and energy management solutions for residential customers.

product.name: Base Battery
product.description: A residential battery system that provides automatic backup power during outages and can be managed to support grid stability. Systems are sized for individual homes and typically range from 20 kWh to 50 kWh.

product.name: Base Backup + Energy
product.description: A bundled residential electricity and battery-backup service that combines a fixed-rate Base electricity plan with an automatically activated home battery system.

product.name: Base Energy
product.description: A residential electricity service offering fixed-rate power without requiring Base battery hardware. It is available in select Texas service areas and includes straightforward billing and utility delivery charges.

product.name: Base Backup Only
product.description: A residential battery-backup service for customers who retain their existing electricity provider. The installed battery automatically supplies power during outages and is available only in selected utility-partnership areas.

identifier.value: Base Grid Balancing and Energy Management

product.name: Base Grid Balancing and Energy Management
product.description: A software-enabled distributed energy management service that coordinates residential batteries for grid balancing, outage readiness, and utility demand support.

product.name: Base Energy for Business
product.description: A fixed-rate commercial electricity service for Texas businesses, designed to provide predictable electricity pricing across eligible ERCOT market areas.
